messages:
Ava Gomez: Hi all, first-day snag. Okta login OK, 1Password invite arrived, but when I try to register a passkey it keeps failing with 'Could not complete registration' and my YubiKey lights up but nothing happens. Also Drive shows 'You need access' for the design-assets folder (403). Anyone seen the YubiKey + Okta flakiness? :grimacing:
it-provisioning-bot: Provisioning: okta_user_created ava.gomez@redwood.com at 2026-06-01T09:04:15Z; google_account_ready at 2026-06-01T09:05:03Z; 1password_invite_sent.
Priya Patel: Welcome Ava! Sorry about that. Two separate things maybe: 1) YubiKey sometimes needs a browser prompt (touch) and a fresh PIN entry depending on OS. Which OS/browser are you using? 2) Drive 403 usually group mapping; paste the folder link and I'll check.
Ava Gomez: macOS Ventura + Chrome. Folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DesignAssetsExample. Chrome prompted for USB but the Okta flow errors after the touch. Tried rebooting the key.
Samir Rao: We had a similar USB/passkey race where the browser blocked the device prompt due to an extension. Try disabling extensions or use an incognito window. Also check chrome://settings/content/usbDevices?search=usb.
Priya Patel: I see the folder is shared to group 'design-core' and new hires start as 'design-onboard' for 24h. I'll add you to design-core manually now.
DevX Bot: Note: passkey-provider reported transient error 502 at 2026-06-01T09:03:58Z for registrations. Auto-retry scheduled.
Ava Gomez: Tried incognito and disabled extensions, still same Okta error. Rebooted YubiKey and it briefly flashed but then Okta page shows the error. Any manual workaround?
Priya Patel: Two quick workarounds: 1) register a TOTP now (Okta -> Profile -> Extra Verification Methods -> Authenticator app) to finish MFA, then try the YubiKey later; 2) if you'd like, I can reset your passkey registration state from the admin console to clear stale sessions. Which do you prefer?
Ava Gomez: I'll do TOTP for now, want to get into repos. One Q: will adding me to design-core give immediate Drive access or do I need to wait?
Samir Rao: It should be immediate but Drive permission cache can delay a minute. If 403 persists after 2-3 minutes try a hard refresh or incognito.
Priya Patel: Added ava.gomez@redwood.com to design-core. Also filed ticket IT-5123: "passkey-provider 502 causing YubiKey registration failures; admin resets required for subset of users".
Ava Gomez: Incognito worked  I can open the folder now. TOTP enrolled and saved backup codes. Thanks! One last: GitHub invite? Didn't get it yet.
Samir Rao: GitHub invites are separate; you should get one within ~10-15m. If not, ping #platform and we'll send a manual invite. For SSH: generate a key and add it to GitHub: 
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ava.gomez@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Ava Gomez: Got the GitHub invite a few minutes later  accepted. Will set up SSH now. Appreciate the quick help everyone :tada:
